name: Instruction following
description: Precise formatting and constraint-following tasks where any deviation is easy to detect.

prompts.prompt: Reply with exactly the word OK in uppercase and nothing else.
Write the word model backwards in uppercase letters. Output only the result.
Sort these words alphabetically and output them separated by commas with no spaces: pear, apple, mango, kiwi
Output the whole numbers from 10 down to 1 on a single line, separated by single spaces, with nothing else.
Repeat the following text exactly, but replace every vowel (a, e, i, o, u) with an asterisk: Small models run fast
Answer only yes or no, in lowercase: is 91 a prime number?

Convert the sentence into a JSON object with exactly two keys, name (string) and age (number). Output only the JSON on one line.

Sentence: Maria is 34 years old.

prompts.system: Always answer in capital letters only.
prompts.prompt: What is the capital of Italy? Answer with one word.
Write the first four letters of the English alphabet in reverse order, separated by hyphens. Output only the result.
Give exactly 3 bullet points, each starting with "- " and each at most 8 words, on why people quantize language models. No introduction or conclusion.
Describe the ocean in a single sentence of exactly seven words. Output only the sentence.
Write two sentences about autumn without using the letter e anywhere.
